unit: records-1 (records-index.tsv rows with ids a to l, 209 rows)
observations: Clusters: the old-base laws of one step (census, counting, balance, imbalance, listing, coarser and finer units, laws-of-one-step and its completeness) form a block of about 20 records. They belong in root as the World model of the grammar, but none is yet restated on Becoming.Grammar. Only five rows in this half are stated on the grammar: continuation-relative-to-a-class, generation-and-degeneration-at-two-grains, candidate-theorems-of-the-corpus, classical-definitions-in-the-grammar and one more. The map rows (regimes, loops, coupling, capture) sit almost entirely on the old base or on general amounts, so re-rooting them on the grammar is the main open move. Duplicates and superseded rows: three drawers-in-turn records (draw-everything, within-capacities, any-number) are folded into drawers-in-turn; two law-through-coupling records are folded into a-law-through-a-projection-along-one-run; conditional-foundation-assessment is superseded; all of these go to retire. The Explanatory/Composition/Joining group (lifting, question recovery, target uniqueness) is large, general-type and weakly tied to the spine: candidates for one representation section. The reviewed-scoped empirical and fidelity rows (no Lean) should stay apart from proved results. Base assignment is inferred from the cited Lean files (Flow/World/Admission mean old-base; Frame/Labelled/Laws mean frame), not re-verified per declaration. Missing: no grammar statement yet for significance, life or collective rows.

unit: modules-1: rows 1-170 of lean-modules-index.tsv (Becoming.World through Becoming.Alternatives)
observations: Rows 2-171 (170 rows, 167 distinct modules). Duplicate index rows: RenewalFlow, HexagramCommuting, FrontierFrames each listed twice with different descriptions (index bug or merged modules; dedupe). Only six modules import Becoming.Grammar (Arising, Change, Identity, ContinuedClasses, Persistence, PatternPassing), and all still read Web; nearly everything else is old-base (World/Web/Flow) or frame (Process/Run). So the root region's grammar is barely used by this half: re-rooting is the main Lean debt. Clusters: modelling-commitment tests (Stuttering, Reordering, IdleRemoval, OrderNormal, Sampling, Tower, Units, Resolution, WholeAmounts, Counting, Standing, CensusTable) belong under method as calibrations of the old base's modelling choices; reach/closure family (EdgeClosure, SeedReach, ScopedReach) duplicates Frame's closure; registration/selection/response cluster spans knowing and significance (alignment); Hexagram* forms a clean classical group; Price/selection cluster for life. Seeking/Capture/RuleCapture/ClosedCapture (无明) are split between map and significance. Witnesses has 0 theorems. Base was assigned by imports and keyword counts from experiments/.../lean/becoming/Becoming/*.lean, not by reading proofs.

211 rows (m–z). Statuses: 200 recorded-checked, 6 reviewed-scoped (naming-attention-coverage, situated-recovery are empirical with no Lean), 4 open targets (scientific-inquiry-foundation, theory-of-becoming-foundation, universal-practical-warrant, wisdom-root), 1 superseded (revision-comes-to-drawing-everything → retire). Base: most rows sit on the old World base (Flow/Dependence); a large frame cluster (Explanatory*, Market*, Bridge/GenerativeComparison ethics); only testing-within-the-net and wen-in-the-grammar are on the grammar; periphery: SlowingDown, Representation/WholeAmounts, plus RegimeReals inside regime-in-any-amounts. Clusters: rest/regime (rest-*, RM2–RM10, thresholds-*) are dense and could merge into one master law; Optimum SG1–SG13 in collective; selection levels (equal-size subsumed by any-sizes); market-* are general viability laws with a market instance, not about collectives. Likely duplicates or candidates to fold: recoverable-mediated-change vs mediated-evidence-transport (same first clause); pending-task-context-applicability and versioned-request-completion are instance-level; wenli-on-the-spine probably superseded by wen-in-the-grammar. Missing: almost nothing in this half is restated on the grammar root yet, so re-basing old-base/frame rows is the main gap. Classical has only 4 rows here.

unit: modules-2 (rows 170-339 of lean-modules-index.tsv; row 170 included in case the halves overlap)
observations:
I used rows 170-339, overlapping the first half by one row in case the split differs. Import closure does not tell bases apart: nearly every module reaches Grammar, World and Frame through hub imports. So I read bases from what each module states: webs, flows, exchange and levels mean old-base; process, law, runs and courses mean frame; any-type means general. Treat these bases as judgment, not mechanical.

The index repeats namespaces (Courses x4, Boundaries x2, Presentations x2, Granularity x2, Composition x2, Likeness x2, MoveFormation x2, Tail x2, Countdown x2). In rows 295-339 the description is a one-line summary, so the TSV module column is probably the namespace, not the file. Those rows need real file names before the move.

Clusters: Joining/Fragments/LocalUnits/JoiningContexts/Codes/Roles plus correspondence and presentation make one root block on frames. Loops/Remainder/Routes/Closing/Thresholds/Frequency/HistorySums/RouteTraces/CouplingTraces make one map block. The F3J ports (Alternatives, Bundles, SecuredContent, Handoff, ProfileReach) belong in significance. The oversight engineering modules (Actuation, Dispatch, Transactions, Acceptance, FaultEnvelopes, envelopes) split between significance and knowing. The *Runs/*Traces instance modules repeat their parents on runs and could merge in their parents' chapter. Nothing is clearly retire.
